obernants.operator: U pairs finite token vectors with lists of matches. R runs descending lengths <=6, ascending starts, candidate order and accepted-row filtering. U\R excludes overlapping chosen multiword spans in one pass and any singleton without derived domains; sentence merge rejects a form multiword overlapping an existing multiword, but can overlap existing singletons.

obernants.operator: Candidate set is literal plus individual possessive->one's replacements; for nonpossessive interior positions of spans>=3 add someone/something/somebody substitutions. No candidate substitutes two positions at once, and placeholders are never generated at edges. Duplicate candidate strings can produce repeated singleton observations because singleton matches do not mark used.

obernants.operator: M(forms,lemmas)=sort(G(lemmas) ++ admitted multiwords from G(forms)). Admission sees already appended form matches and ignores singletons for overlap. Swapping forms and lemmas can alter chosen spans and entries; this merge is not a symmetric union or global maximum-length optimizer.
